summary: Wrote a 5-phase, ~4-hour plan to stop the Sapience token being written into the per-project MCP entry. Phase 1 measures mcp.py's token resolution with SAPIENCE_TOKEN unset; Phase 2 drops the token branch from the writer and inverts verifier check (b) as one atomic batch; Phase 3 adds the regression case plus its negative control; Phase 4 documents the token's homes and the never-copy boundary; Phase 5 (final, full tier) migrates the live entries, verifies end to end, and redeploys. Re-measured every carried figure against live state: 6 of 6 project entries in ~/.claude.json carry the token today, and no mcp.py path needs the variable.

artifacts.summary: 5 phases, 4 dependency waves, ~4 hours: measure mcp.py fallback, writer+verifier atomic batch, regression test with negative control, token-location documentation, live migration and end-to-end verification.
